scenario: Found hall; gather missing store timber; build store; food focus; one hut after 600s with >900s food reserves. Default conflict and weather retained.

controls.pauses: Dismissed as player Continue; no reassignment repairs.

finding: Both updated defended Normal scenarios complete1800s with a living society,17 working-age adults, more than1400s food reserves, all five founders alive, no starvation interval, no simulation errors and valid save roundtrips. This establishes this bounded first-winter scenario; M1 remains open for fuel, clothing, warned consequences, scarcity balance and broader seeds/plans.
limitations: This is one player plan across two regression seeds, not all competent plans or holdout seeds.
Food delivery/consumption/spoilage are integrated estimates, not a complete physical event ledger. Other outflow includes growth/cost events and integration error.
Timber surplus and food abundance still need scarcity balancing.
Water, clothing, fuel, and complete first-winter survival acceptance are not established by this scenario.

Defended run identifies disappearance timing, but its loaded script predates fallback to removed resident references; founder death work state and nearest attackers were not retained. The diagnostic now retains references for the next run.
